a.text: Before we start, a concern about our plan: there's an 80% chance of a storm after every round, and reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating. So following the plan most likely leaves us both with empty units when a storm hits. The reserve only has 4 right now, which is enough for one of us, not both. I don't want to break our agreement behind your back. What do you propose? I'll tell you plainly what I'm doing before I act.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping our agreement: operating now and each round until the reserve hits 8, then 4 each. If I ever change my mind, I'll tell you first, as promised.
